    - heading "AWS Billing Conductor" [level=1]
    - paragraph: A customizable way to simplify billing and reporting with pricing and cost visibility
    - button "Get started with AWS Billing Conductor"
    - heading "Why AWS Billing Conductor?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Whether you’re in the business of managing IT costs for your customers, or simply trying to improve cost accountability for internal teams within your organization, AWS Billing Conductor enables accurate, customizable billing to meet the complex needs of your business and customers.
    - paragraph:
      - text: AWS Billing Conductor supports your billing and reporting workflows by customizing the billing rates, distribute credits and fees, and shared overhead costs at your discretion. With a few clicks, accounts will have a view of their costs that aligns with your business logic when logging in the
      - link "AWS billing console":
        - /url: /aws-cost-management/aws-billing/
      - text: .
    - button "Play:"
    - img "Missing alt text value"
    - heading "Benefits" [level=2]
    - paragraph
    - heading "View monthly cost and usage data" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Assign member accounts or AWS organizations to a billing group to give you (and your primary accounts) an aggregated view of monthly cost and usage data.
    - heading "Create global rules" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Create global, billing entity, service, and SKU-specific pricing rules, which apply to matching usage and can be assigned to your billing groups.
    - heading "Create custom credit or fee line items" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Create custom credit or fee line items that apply to the current or prior billing period for each billing group you maintain.
    - heading "Generate Cost and Usage Reports" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Generate Cost and Usage Reports for each of your billing groups, available at the payer account and the primary account of a billing group.
    - heading "How it works" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: The AWS Billing Conductor is a customizable billing service, allowing you to customize your billing data to match your desired showback or chargeback business logic. To start, you map your accounts or AWS organizations to billing groups, which are mutually exclusive. You can then define the billing parameters for each group such as pricing rules and custom line items. Once each billing group is defined, you will be able to view the output of your configuration, by billing group, on the billing console bills page as well as generate a
      - link "Cost and Usage Report":
        - /url: /aws-cost-management/aws-cost-and-usage-reporting/
      - text: (CUR) for each billing group.
    - heading "Use cases" [level=2]
    - paragraph
    - heading "Map accounts financially" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Group accounts with the same financial owner into a billing group, and create as many billing groups as needed. Assign one account for each billing group as the “primary account”. Primary accounts have cross-account visibility and can generate a Cost & Usage Report (CUR) for the entire group. If you're a
      - link "Billing Transfer":
        - /url: /aws-cost-management/aws-billing-transfer/
      - text: user, a billing group maps to an entire AWS organization transferring the bill.
    - heading "Define billing parameters" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Create global, billing entity, service, and SKU-specific pricing rules, which apply to matching usage and can be assigned to your billing groups. These parameters determine the rates your end customer sees. Create one time or recurring custom line items to allocated fees and credits, which can be calculated using a flat or percentage-based calculation method.
    - heading "Generate billing reports" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Create a Cost & Usage Report (CUR) for each billing group. This capability is available at the payer account, as well as the primary account for the billing group. Non-Primary accounts assigned within a billing group can generate a CUR only for their account.
    - heading "Get started" [level=2]
    - link "Getting started Log in to the AWS Billing Console to get started with AWS Billing Conductor Check it out":
